Declared drafts for one brief (fixture).

## Draft 1
Title: Wide table, one row per item
Structure:
- a single table
- one row per item, one column per attribute
Trade-off: dense; hard to read on a narrow screen
Commitment: layout=table, grouping=none

## Draft 2
Title: Cards grouped by state
Structure:
- one card per item
- cards grouped under state headings
Trade-off: scans well; hides cross-item comparison

## Draft 3
Title: Timeline of events
Structure:
- a vertical timeline
- each event links to its item
Trade-off: shows order; loses the current snapshot
Commitment: layout=timeline, grouping=time
